item.title: Version 1.6
item.description: Conversations, Undo (⌘Z), one-click Unsubscribe, Remind Me (snooze), Send Later, follow-up reminders, standing Clean Up rules, an attachment browser with Quick Look, an Inbox filter (People / Newsletters / Receipts), copyable sign-in codes, and Show as Designed for emails that look wrong in dark mode.
